summary: Compute fixed-order, fixed-size normalized residuals for each predeclared observation channel; a missing prediction or an inconsistent unit is rejected. Return the residual vector and chi2 as a scirel._result.Result mapping.

capability: Compute fixed-order, fixed-size normalized residuals for each predeclared observation channel.
operation: fully matched predictions and observations -> residual vector and squared sum
discovery.model: Diagonal sigma-weighted least squares with no covariance, degrees-of-freedom correction or instrument model.
discovery.geometry: No geometry computation; the caller aligns observation and prediction locations.
discovery.boundary: Values must be nonempty and finite, sigma finite and positive, residuals and chi2 representable, and an explicit unit must match predicted.units.

identity.relation: fully matched predictions and observations to normalized residuals and a squared sum
identity.definition: First validate the observation layout, then take flux_loops, thomson.density, electron_temperature, p_parallel and p_perp in that fixed order. Every requested channel requires a prediction with exactly the same shape as values; compute (prediction-values)/sigma, flatten and concatenate in NumPy C order, and set chi2=r·r. sigma defaults to 1 and may broadcast; a channel whose prediction is missing is never skipped. The residual_vector and chi2 fields are returned in a scirel._result.Result mapping; mapping and attribute access expose the same values.
identity.model: diagonal sigma-weighted least squares with no covariance, degrees-of-freedom correction or instrument model
identity.geometry: no geometry computation; the caller is responsible for aligning observation and prediction locations
identity.coordinates: flux first, followed by the four profile channels in fixed order; within a channel, NumPy C order
identity.boundary: values must be nonempty and finite, sigma finite and positive, and residuals and chi2 representable; an explicit unit must match predicted.units.
assumptions: Values and sigma share one unit and one sample correspondence.
Records without a declared unit remain usable as pure normalized algebra; this does not establish physical unit compatibility.

Each complete original-input binary-rational difference divided by sigma is rounded once to float64; the subtraction is not rounded separately. chi2 is the complete squared sum of those returned float64 residual entries, accumulated before one final rounding, independently of sample count or a rounded total-value threshold. A positive result below its final float64 rounding threshold may still round to zero.

inputs.name: predicted
inputs.description: Per-channel predictions; when an observation declares a unit, matching units metadata must also be supplied.
inputs.shape: mapping; flux_loops array and/or thomson mapping
inputs.constraints: Every requested channel must be present, finite and exactly the same shape; a missing Thomson channel is not allowed.

inputs.name: observations
inputs.description: flux_loops and/or thomson requests, each channel containing values, an optional sigma and an optional unit.
inputs.units: values and sigma in the same unit
inputs.constraints: Only known kinds/channels are allowed; values must be nonempty and finite; sigma defaults to 1 and must be positive and broadcastable; a unit, if present, must be a nonempty string.

outputs.name: residual_vector
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: signed normalized residuals concatenated in the fixed channel order.
outputs.constraints: N is determined by the total number of observation values, not by the available predictions; all entries are finite.

outputs.name: chi2
outputs.description: Field of the returned scirel._result.Result mapping: sum of squared residuals, without division by degrees of freedom.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative, equal to the inner product of residual_vector.

preconditions: Predictions and observations refer to the same points, use the same units and are arranged in the same shapes.
supported: Multi-channel normalized residuals with diagonal sigma weights.
Strict presence, shape and explicit-unit matching for every requested channel.
excluded: Correlated-noise covariance, instrument calibration, degrees-of-freedom correction or fit-significance decisions.
Automatically shrinking the fit problem based on remaining predictions.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for empty or unknown observations, missing predictions, empty or nonfinite values, wrong shapes, nonpositive sigma or inconsistent explicit units.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: A genuinely overflowing final normalized residual or squared sum is reported as ValueError. Every normalized difference and the complete squared sum are evaluated before their final rounding; no failing channel or contribution is dropped.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iteration; forward validity is judged separately by the trial layer.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial scirel._result.Result mapping is returned after dropping a failing channel.

example.description: Flux residuals precede perpendicular-pressure residuals, units are explicitly bound, and the result is a named mapping.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel._result import Result
from scirel.diagnostics import reduce_observation_residuals
r=reduce_observation_residuals(predicted={'flux_loops':[3.],'thomson':{'p_perp':[5.]},'units':{'flux_loops':'Wb','thomson':{'p_perp':'Pa'}}}, observations={'flux_loops':{'values':[1.],'sigma':[2.],'unit':'Wb'},'thomson':{'p_perp':{'values':[3.],'sigma':[1.],'unit':'Pa'}}})
assert isinstance(r, Result)
assert r.residual_vector is r['residual_vector']
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['residual_vector'],[1.,2.])
assert r['chi2']==5.
example.expected: The fixed-order vector remains [1, 2] and chi2 remains 5, with the same keys and values exposed by mapping key and attribute through scirel._result.Result; a missing p_perp prediction must fail.

scope: Retains the original normalization and sigma numerical assertions.
Rejects a mixed flux and Thomson request when any channel is missing; rejects unit conflicts and empty values.
Fixed-size trial composition with the real forward inversion.
Result wrapping preserves both keys, key order, residual vector value/shape/dtype, chi2 and mapping access against baseline 0f74255b; attribute access reaches the same fields.

Raw-input Fraction references with fixed rtol=1e-13 and atol=0 cover the recoverable difference at prediction=2^1023, observation=-2^1023, sigma=2^1023 and the four-term squared sum at residual=2^-538, together with adjacent scales, signs, cancellation and final subnormal rounding controls.

Direct controls retain channel/C order, scalar and array shapes, broadcast sigma, strict declared-unit matching, input nonmutation, Result access and genuine final-overflow rejection; these are bounded algebraic checks, not statistical significance or complete-domain validation.

Raw-input regressions separately check finite subnormal residual rounding and normal complete squared sums with individually subnormal or unrepresentable square contributions, including a mixed tiny tail and repeated non-power-of-two residuals; no final-total or sample-count exception defines the arithmetic.

Independent evidence (test_reduction_evidence): each normalized residual (prediction - observation) / sigma is rebuilt in exact rational arithmetic; the fixed channel order is checked against a mapping whose channels are inserted in reverse, so an implementation walking the input mapping fails; the vector is checked to be affine in the prediction with slope 1/sigma and exactly zero when prediction equals observation; chi2 is checked to be the sum of the returned residual squares; and the declared unit-label gating is checked as a rejection and as a pass-through.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Author regressions, independent analytic and independent discrete-reference comparisons, and selected installed-wheel user calls completed in the exact environment; they cover only the listed contract and examples. Root-level independent intake, human scientific recognition, redistribution permission and public release are separate decisions; they do not extend this to arbitrary closures, devices or global identifiability proofs. C1 evidence adds: Exact rational normalized residuals and the fixed channel order.
known_limitations: unit is a declared match only; units are not converted automatically and instrument calibration is not verified.
chi2 is only the algebraic squared sum under the stated diagonal weights; it cannot be interpreted alone as statistical significance.
cannot establish any statistical interpretation: chi2 is the declared algebraic diagonal-weight sum, and no goodness-of-fit, covariance, calibration or significance claim is made or verified here.

basis.statement: Independent analytic and independent discrete-reference comparisons cover the listed contract and examples; root-level independent intake, human scientific acceptance and broader applicability are not inferred.
